6804.title: Dependency resolutions and merge target poisoning
6804.rootCauseOneLine: The locked dependency inventory matches four advisory ranges; deepmerge 4.3.1 copies target keys without guarding prototype-changing assignment.

prReviews.verdict: NOT VALIDATED — static inspection only; closed and not merged
prReviews.topFinding: Six-file dependency, lockfile, and packaging changes are outside the autopilot simple-fix policy; no PR code was executed.

6804.proposedFix: Review compatible dependency upgrades and a target/source merge-key mitigation, regenerate the lockfile, and verify affected consumers in a separate dependency-maintenance change.
6804.caveats: The verdict covers advisory-matching lockfile resolutions and a repeated dependency-level deepmerge failure, not remote exploitability in bb. No new fix or PR was attempted because dependency, lockfile, and packaging changes are excluded.
